parameters.query:
SELECT al.id, al.title, al.severity, al.status, al.source, al.source_ip, al.risk_score, al.asset_id, al.metadata, al.detected_at,
  a.name AS asset_name, a.ip_address AS asset_ip, a.criticality AS asset_criticality, a.risk_score AS asset_risk_score,
  u.full_name AS asset_owner_name, u.email AS asset_owner_email
FROM alerts al LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.id = al.asset_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.owner_id
WHERE al.id = '{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.entityId }}' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO incidents (title, description, severity, status, priority, category, detected_at, sla_due_at, incident_key, metadata)
VALUES ('Phishing credential compromise — automated P1', 'n8n detonated the payload, purged matching mail and forced credential rotation.',
'critical', 'open', 'P1', 'phishing', now(), now() + interval '2 hours',
'AUTO-' || upper(substr(md5('{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.executionId }}'), 1, 10)),
jsonb_build_object('automation', 'phishing-triage', 'executionId', '{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.executionId }}', 'entityId', '{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.entityId }}'))
ON CONFLICT (incident_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now() RETURNING id, incident_key;

INSERT INTO tickets (subject, status, priority, description, metadata)
SELECT 'Automated phishing triage', 'open', 'high', 'Reported message routed for analyst review after automated triage.',
jsonb_build_object('automation', 'phishing-triage', 'executionId', '{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.executionId }}')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets WHERE metadata->>'executionId' = '{{ $('🔍 Kiểm tra dữ liệu').first().json.executionId }}')
RETURNING id;
